New7Patch11M365UserReadAllDelegated.Title: Read M365 Graph user profile in profile card
New7Patch11M365UserReadAllDelegated.Description: Allows the display of Entra ID properties to be configured directly on the profile card.
New7Patch11M365UserReadAllDelegated.ConsentInformation: Allows the app to read the complete set of profile properties, reports, and managers of other users in your organisation, on behalf of the signed-in user.

ManagedMetadataProperties.Title: Write managed metadata properties
ManagedMetadataProperties.Description: Allows the app to read, create, update, and delete managed metadata and to read basic site information on behalf of the signed-in user.

GptImageProvider.Title: GPT image
GptImageProvider.FeatureDescription: Activate this feature to add the option 'Generate GPT image' to the media picker.
GptImageProvider.ErrorMessage: The task failed. Please check your configuration and try again.
GptImageProvider.PromptContent: Prompts can be composed of any words, but consider how you can explain an image to someone. The structure of "subject + adjectives + styles" tends to work well.
GptImageProvider.PromptExample: Describe the image you want to create. For example: "watercolour painting of the Seattle skyline"
GptImageProvider.Label: Prompt
